title: Two Nines
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Two doors say nine. Only one is mine.
first_visual: A corridor where one door should be: two identical doors, both numbered 9, timer light ticking.

beats.visual: Earlier: Ivy wheels her bike in; the handlebar scrapes her door at knee height (subtle).
Now: two identical doors, both 9; one peephole glows; one mat is crooked.
beats.vo: Two doors say nine. Only one is mine.

beats.visual: On-screen: WHICH DOOR? LEFT or RIGHT, 3-2-1 freeze.
beats.vo: Which do I open? Decide now.

beats.visual: Replay of 0:01, zoomed: the scrape is on the right-hand door.
beats.vo: Watch the start again. The bike.

beats.visual: Ivy touches the scrape on the right door and opens it: her warm flat.
Key moment: behind her, the left door's lit peephole goes dark; the door fades into plain wall.
beats.vo: The other one watched me choose.

beats.visual: Card: 'Did you spot the scrape first time? Comment the second you saw it.'

ending: She opens the right door: home. Behind her, the left door's peephole goes dark, then the door is plain wall.
loop_note: Partial. The final card points back to the start for a rewatch, which is the point of the format.

interactive_prompt.reveal: in-video at 0:16, with replay of the planted clue (bike scrape, 0:01)

originality_review: Original 'which door' puzzle with a fair-play clue. A choose-a-door premise is generic; the scrape clue and the watching false door are ours.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Ivy comes home to two identical doors marked 9. The viewer picks left or right during a 3-second freeze. The fair clue is a bike scrape shown at the start. The wrong door watched her choose, then becomes wall.

hooks.line: Two doors say nine. Only one is mine.

hooks.line: Pick the right door before the light goes out.
hooks.first_visual: A finger on a glowing timer switch.

hooks.line: The answer was in the first five seconds.
hooks.first_visual: A bike handlebar brushing a door.

hooks.line: One peephole was lit. From inside.

hooks.line: The other door watched me choose.

conflict: Choose the real door with red herrings in play (a lit peephole, a crooked mat).
